title: Squared derivative and pivotality
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ map the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$ to $\\{-1,1\\}$, and choose a coordinate $i$ and a point $x$ in the cube. The square of the discrete derivative of the real-valued version of $f$ at $x$ equals $1$ if flipping coordinate $i$ changes the value of $f$, and equals $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a point of the sign cube
